# `rename_list`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Change the display name of an existing object list.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xe8050, ObjListConfig::RenameList @0x6c38b0 (64-bit build) |

Changes the stored list-name attribute of the list called old to new. Objects inside the list are untouched.

Side effects: Rewrites the list-name attribute in the persistent XML configuration, synchronously.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"rename_list"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|array | no | - | Object with old and new, or a positional array of two strings [old, new]. Any other container yields an empty map and therefore 105. No length, range or default handling. [READ] |

Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | old or new missing, null or not a string (or wrong params container) | `expected string param` |
| 236 | The configuration root or the old list is not found | `xml item is not found` |
| 225 | A list with the new display name already exists | `xml item already exists` |
| 234 | Lower XML attribute-setting step: configuration file name storage is empty | `xml file name is empty` |
| 229 | Lower XML attribute-setting step: the XML key could not be opened | `fail to open xml key` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Lower-level codes 234 and 229 are established for the 64-bit XML attribute-setting only; 32-bit equivalence is not asserted.

## Example

Request, rename:

```json
{"id":61,"method":"rename_list","params":{"old":"Winter targets","new":"Winter 2026"}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"rename_list","result":0,"code":0,"id":61}
```

Reply, name-taken:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"rename_list","error":"xml item already exists","code":225,"id":62}
```
